technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals (StochRSI, Williams %R) with Ichimoku cloud support, but price structure remains below key moving averages and momentum indicators lack bullish confirmation—moderate reversal setup with elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 62 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional (junior member, small trades); market fear (41 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (317), strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 62 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: StochRSI oversold with bullish crossup, Williams %R rising, and Ichimoku cloud support create a textbook mean-reversion setup at 103.65 support in a fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price structure is fundamentally broken (below all major moving averages), momentum lacks conviction (RSI neutral, no PSAR/Hull confirmation), macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), and earnings binary risk in 62 days eliminates margin of safety.

decision.entry_rationale: StochRSI oversold bounce with Ichimoku cloud support offers tactical mean-reversion setup; however, macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) and broken price structure eliminate margin of safety required for conviction entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 62 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signals and price below all major moving averages creates uncompensated downside risk that oversold technicals cannot offset.
